sentences.text: Saw II is a 2005 American horror film , a sequel to 2004 's Saw and the second installment in the seven-part Saw franchise , directed and co-written by Darren Lynn Bousman .	Darren Lynn Bousman	Darren Lynn Bousman	Saw	Saw (2004 film)	horror film	horror film	sequel	sequel

Co-written with series creator Leigh Whannell , it stars Donnie Wahlberg , Franky G , Glenn Plummer , Beverley Mitchell , Dina Meyer , Emmanuelle Vaugier , Erik Knudsen , Shawnee Smith , and Tobin Bell .	Leigh Whannell	Leigh Whannell	Donnie Wahlberg	Donnie Wahlberg	Franky G	Franky G	Glenn Plummer	Glenn Plummer	Beverley Mitchell	Beverley Mitchell	Dina Meyer	Dina Meyer	Emmanuelle Vaugier	Emmanuelle Vaugier	Erik Knudsen	Erik Knudsen	Shawnee Smith	Shawnee Smith	Tobin Bell	Tobin Bell

The film features Jigsaw being apprehended by the police , but trapping the arresting officer in one of his own games while showing another game of eight people -- including the officer 's son -- in progress on TV monitors at another location .	Jigsaw	Jigsaw (Saw)
It also explores some of John Kramer 's backstory , providing a partial explanation of his reason for becoming Jigsaw .	Jigsaw	Jigsaw (Saw)	backstory	backstory
After the financial success of Saw , a sequel was immediately green-lit .	Saw	Saw (2004 film)	sequel	sequel
Leigh Whannell and James Wan were busy preparing for their next film and were unable to write or direct .	Leigh Whannell	Leigh Whannell	James Wan	James Wan
Bousman wrote a script called The Desperate before Saw was released and was looking for a producer but many studios rejected it .	Saw	Saw (2004 film)
Hoffman received the script and showed it to his partners Mark Burg and Oren Koules .	Mark Burg	Mark Burg	Oren Koules	Oren Koules
It was decided that , with some changes , it could be made into Saw II .	Saw	Saw (2004 film)
Whannell became available to provide rewrites of the script .
The film was given a larger budget and was shot from May to June 2005 in Toronto .

Saw II was released on October 28 , 2005 and , despite mixed reviews from critics , was a financial success , with opening takings of $ 31.9 million and grossing $ 88 million in the United States and Canada .	Saw	Saw (2004 film)
It has remained the highest grossing Saw film in those countries .	Saw	Saw (2004 film)
Bell was nominated for `` Best Villain '' at the 2006 MTV Movie Awards for his role as Jigsaw in the film .	Jigsaw	Jigsaw (Saw)	2006 MTV Movie Awards	2006 MTV Movie Awards
Saw II was released to DVD on and topped charts its first week , selling more than 3 million units .	Saw	Saw (2004 film)	DVD	DVD
At the time , it was the fastest-selling theatrical DVD in Lionsgate 's history .	DVD	DVD
